free_text: The decision to defer biopsy is supported by the panel protocol, which was triggered by an identical precedent in the labelled series. This decision was reinforced by the registrar retrieving the documented prior diagnosis of ISUP grade group 3 malignancy, which overrides the conflicting signals from the PI-RADS 5 and rising PSA trend. The evidence converged on deferral because the documented prior diagnosis was the decisive factor retrieved by the registrar.
